test_vectors.coverage: Bare records, Config and EndpointModel wrappers, mandatory version, empty model collections, incorrect wrappers, Unit and tuple shape rejection.
Inherited service name, endpoint roles and description, explicit empty roles and description, enclosing service precedence, absent endpoint fields, and no invented role declarations.
Empty defaults, exact Defaults wrapper, direct service strings, None and Some(string), explicit empty strings and vectors, and verbatim descriptions.
Bare Some, payload-bearing None, missing or multiple Some arguments, named option payloads, incorrect inner types, unknown wrappers and keys, and invalid sequence shapes.

Every named record wrapper, services, endpoints, fields, definitions, enum variants, roles, global errors and headers; ordering, metadata, u16/u32/i32 boundaries, header defaults and explicit false, unresolved references, and stream types.
All fifteen scalar identifiers map to canonical EndpointType variants; scalar payload variants are rejected.
All eight payload type variants, NanoId width endpoints, Struct and Enum empty defaults, EnumRef boolean defaults, single-argument trailing commas, and nested Optional/Vec types.
Unknown and misspelled type tags, case sensitivity, quoted type expressions, incorrect node shapes, and missing payloads for known payload type tags.
StructRef, Vec and Optional reject empty, multi-argument and named payloads; manually constructed non-tuple payloads are rejected at their byte offset.
Record payload shape validation, unknown type/Field/EnumVariant keys, missing required payload keys, invalid collection values, and non-boolean EnumRef flags.
Legal zero ids/codes, u16/u32 maxima, negative zero, manually constructed signed nonnegative integers, u8 range failures, i32 limits, and signed/unsigned 64-bit overflow cases.
Service ids, endpoint and global error codes, NanoId lengths and enum discriminants reject values immediately outside their destination width and negative unsigned values.
Boolean and quoted numeric values are not coerced into ids, codes, NanoId lengths or enum discriminants.
Strict three-component versions, u32 maxima, component overflow, missing/extra components, leading zeros, signs, whitespace, prefixes, suffixes and Unicode digits; exact config-node error offsets.
Bare and Version-wrapped records, mandatory major/minor/patch, u32 widths, unknown fields, wrong wrappers and incorrect scalar or tuple shapes.
Missing codes or names, conflicting name/method aliases including identical aliases, fully qualified names, service case mismatch, and valid method aliases.
Absent service defaults, explicit None, mandatory ids, empty effective service names, and explicit service names overriding defaults.
None, Some(type), direct scalar and compound types, nested Optional types, malformed option wrappers with precise offsets, incorrect payload types and nested Some rejection.
Required keys in definitions, fields, roles, errors, headers and enum variants, plus manually constructed empty NanoId and StructTable records.
Unknown keys in every model section, unsupported endpoint errors/error/error_refs fields, and rejection instead of silently discarding input.
All record vocabularies, bare and wrapped manual syntax, duplicate values at a distinct byte offset, and public normalization entry points with duplicate keys.
Wrong wrappers in defaults, services, endpoints, definitions, fields, roles, errors, headers and enum variants, plus manually nested matching wrappers.
All model collection shapes, endpoint params/response/roles, role includes, required booleans, descriptions, messages and quoted names.
Empty service, endpoint, field, definition, role, role-reference, error, header, struct, enum, variant and type-reference names.
Unknown keys after UTF-8 comments, numeric overflow, missing record fields, nested unknown type tags and manually constructed u32::MAX diagnostic offsets.
Depth zero, MAX_REFERENCE_DEPTH minus one, the exact boundary and one excessive ownership edge, using both Vec chains and mixed Struct/Optional/Vec nesting.
Exact and excessive nesting for definitions, headers, params, response, direct stream responses and Some-wrapped stream responses.
References remain unresolved, duplicate endpoint/error codes and role declarations retain their original values for subsequent validation, and header casing is preserved.
Unicode field names, descriptions containing escaped tab/NUL/newline, spelling and casing preservation, deterministic repeated normalization, and input-tree immutability.

status.review: Source manually reviewed against the frozen RON contract, canonical ABI endpoint/error definitions, endpoint-model depth semantics, root signatures and Wave 1 parser shapes.
status.validation: Tests authored but not executed. No cargo, rustc, rustfmt, build, check or git commit command was run, as instructed.
notes: Only crates/jmax-endpoint-ron/src/normalize.rs and this assigned report were edited.
Production code uses alloc and core, introduces no dependencies and contains no unsafe code.
Record validation checks duplicate and unknown keys before consuming values, including manually constructed syntax trees.
Type roots have depth zero and accept at most MAX_REFERENCE_DEPTH ownership edges, matching endpoint-model registry semantics.
String and vector allocations reserve fallibly; allocation failures return BudgetExhausted.
All local errors use canonical ABI Error with SchemaCompile source, relevant node offsets and static detail strings. No schema or field ids are invented.
Quoted versions delegate to the contracted Wave 4 version::parse_semver function; returned diagnostic offsets are relocated to the configuration string node.
Name resolution, duplicate-code validation, canonical naming rules and model invariants remain the responsibility of subsequent model validation.
Bare Record nodes and the contract's exact named wrappers are accepted; Unit payloads are not silently converted to records.
